Draw actual intermediate anatomy/leaf/wing/limb motion, not motion blur, double exposure or copies shifted across the sheet. EXACTLY SIX columns by FOUR rows, 24 separate poses matching the reference. Rows: idle/walking, action (attack/production/healing/blocking), hurt/recovery, defeat/wilt/dissolve.
